Welcome to Jiadhal College
Jiadhal College, established in 1995, is one of the premier institutions of higher education in the
outskirt of Dhemaji Town in the district. The college is located at a suitable position between railways
and motorways and communicable from many distant and near places through a criss cross of streets
and 8 Kms. from Dhemaji Town on N.H.15 towards direct west and takes turn towards direct North
from Jiadhal Chariali Bazar Point. The need of a higher educational institution in flood ridden rural
Jiadhal was long felt by the intelligential and the people of this place for reaching out to a large section
of students from different ethnic communities of this backward area. As an academic destination, the
college primarily aims at providing advance knowledge and higher education to the learners of this vast
and economically backward area on the door step and at low cost.
The college campus spreads over a sufficient stretch of land about 25 bighas. The extensive
green view of the lovely cornfield, fresh open air, a Seri-plantation in the vicinity of the college, the
thatched bamboo houses near by, several concrete buildings, buildings under construction, the serenity
of the place,

Principal Message
Welcome to the official website of Jiadhal College, Dhemaji, Assam, a centre of higher learning located in a rural setting with a
strong commitment to academic excellence and social responsibility. With the aim of inclusive education, the institution is established to
serve students from rural and backward areas to make higher education accessible and meaningful.Since its establishment,
Jiadhal College has played a vital role in expanding access to quality higher education in this region.
Our institution plays a crucial role in empowering first-generation learners through quality education. We have tried to create an
online resource that provides all relevant information about Jiadhal College and
I hope that as you peruse through the contents of this website you will get sense of the rich flavour of life at our college.
Jiadhal College is dedicated to nurturing knowledge, skills, and values among young minds.
Our institution stands as a beacon of knowledge, nurturing young minds with values, skills, and vision for the future.
